2607.01480.title: Procedural Memory Distillation: Online Reflection for Self-Improving Language Models
2607.01480.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), along with recent selfdistillation variants such as SDPO, evaluates each rollout against a verifier and updates the policy from that episode-level signal. However, the richer procedural information in the rollout is rarely retained or reused. Across episodes and epochs, the model repeatedly encounters related problems under a changing policy, producing cross-episode signals that episode-local updates cannot capture: which strategies consistently pass verification, which failure modes persist, which patterns recur. We propose Procedural Memory Distillation (PMD), which converts these crossepisode signals into reusable procedural memory and distills it into the policy's weights during training. This memory functions as a training scaffold, absorbed into the policy itself, yielding a memory-free model at inference. PMD organizes the memory at three levels of abstraction: raw trajectories, self-reflected strategies and lessons, and higher-level behavioral patterns that recur across problems, all extracted online from the model's own trajectories. A memory-conditioned self-teacher draws on the accumulated experience to supervise the student on its own rollouts, enabling student to progressively internalize procedural knowledge within its parameters. The central design principle is co-evolution: the policy generates rollouts that update the memory, and memory shapes the supervision that updates the policy. Empirically, across Qwen3-8B and OLMo3-Instruct-7B, PMD improves over SDPO by 3.8-5.5% on SCIKNOWEVAL and 7.9-13.6% on LIVECODEBENCH. Co-evolution powers these gains: freezing either the memory or the policy trails PMD by more than 10% across SCIKNOWEVAL domains.
2607.01480.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習與可驗證獎勵（RLVR），以及最近的自我蒸餾變體如SDPO，對每次回合進行驗證並根據該回合的信號更新策略。然而，回合中的豐富程序資訊很少被保留或重用。在不同的回合和時期中，模型在變化的策略下重複遇到相關問題，產生的跨回合信號是回合本地更新無法捕捉的：哪些策略始終通過驗證，哪些失敗模式持續存在，哪些模式重複出現。我們提出了程序記憶蒸餾（PMD），它將這些跨回合信號轉換為可重用的程序記憶，並在訓練過程中將其蒸餾到策略的權重中。這種記憶作為訓練支架，吸收到策略本身中，從而在推理時產生無記憶模型。PMD在三個抽象層次上組織記憶：原始軌跡、自我反思的策略和教訓，以及跨問題重複出現的更高層次行為模式，這些都是從模型自身的軌跡中在線提取的。一個記憶條件的自我教師利用累積的經驗來監督學生在其自身回合中的表現，使學生能夠逐步內化程序知識於其參數中。核心設計原則是共同進化：策略生成的回合更新記憶，而記憶塑造更新策略的監督。實證上，在Qwen3-8B和OLMo3-Instruct-7B上，PMD在SKNOWEVAL上比SDPO提高了3.8-5.5%，在LIVECODEBENCH上提高了7.9-13.6%。共同進化推動了這些增益：凍結記憶或策略中的任何一方，PMD在SKNOWEVAL領域的表現都會下降超過10%。
